title: OSGARD comparable product-builder tasks
rules: Use a new account or isolated workspace for every run.
Record an uncut screen capture and retain the resulting public preview URL.
Use the exact prompt without product-specific shortcuts.
Measure from submit to the first inspectable preview, not to a loading indicator.
Do not report a provider score without evidenceUrl and capturedAt.

tasks.prompt: Build a marketplace for independent designers in a Diamond Cosmos visual style. Visitors must discover products, open a product page, add an item to cart, and reach a clear checkout action. Make it mobile-ready and accessible.

Build an AI operator workspace for a product team. Include a task queue, evidence status, approval step, and a clear action to publish a verified release. Make state and next actions understandable without documentation.
